## TickLib.assertTickAlignedToSpacing() function

Asserts that a tick is aligned to the provided spacing.

This is an SDK-only tick-domain assertion.

**Signature:**

```typescript
function assertTickAlignedToSpacing(tick: BigIntish, spacing?: BigIntish): bigint;
```

**Returns:**

bigint

Tick as a bigint.

## Exceptions

`NegativeValueError` when `tick` is negative.

`TickOutOfRangeError` when `tick` exceeds `MAX_TICK`<!-- -->.

`InvalidTickSpacingError` when spacing is invalid or the tick is not aligned.

## Example


```ts
import { TickLib } from "@morpho-org/midnight-sdk";

TickLib.assertTickAlignedToSpacing(100n, 4n);
```
